row_check.notes: All non-empty columns evidenced. Empty ca_measure confirmed: 'competitiveness' occurs only as OIPT framing (p.2), no CA construct is measured. quality_notes is source-based (matched sample p.6, endogeneity essential p.1/9). Coded effect_direction 'positive' rests on the preferred IV and DiD estimates (positive on 4 of 5 measures, ROA null); the paper's own ROA explanation is the nonprofit sample composition (p.13).
